Elasticity (physics).question: The _____ was Physical property when materials or objects return to original shape after deformation.
Elasticity (physics).fact: In continuum mechanics and materials science, elasticity is the ability of a body to resist a distorting influence and to return to its original size and shape when that influence or force is removed.
